units.source_text: 傍晚7点扣分抵达京都的我，在便衣警官的护送下来到了鹿苑寺的山门前。

en.t: Having arrived in Kyoto at a little after seven in the evening, I was escorted by plainclothes police officers to the front gate of Rokuonji Temple.

units.source_text: 这是一个冷飕飕的夜晚。

en.t: It was a bitterly cold night.

units.source_text: 走出了黑xuxu的绵延的松林，山门的顽固形象通将过来的时候，我看到了站在门前的母亲。

en.t: After coming out of the dark, endlessly stretching pine woods, just as the stubborn shape of the temple gate drew near, I saw my mother standing in front of it.
